accounts.direct_browser_verification_desc: Google has provided a direct verification URL for this session. Click the button to authenticate in your browser, complete the sign-in check, and then re-check the account.
accounts.verification_method_1_title: Method 1 (Fastest & Recommended): Verify in Browser or Scan with Another Phone
accounts.verification_method_1_desc: Open this direct verification link in your browser. If desktop verification loops or fails, scan or open the link on another mobile phone (preferably on cellular data) — Google trusts second devices and usually validates instantly without phone SMS!
accounts.scan_with_phone_tooltip: Show QR code to scan with another mobile phone
accounts.scan_with_phone_hint: Scan this QR code with the camera on another mobile phone to verify. Using mobile data (4G/5G) avoids desktop IP blocks.
accounts.verification_method_2_title: Method 2 (Fallback): Google Cloud Shell SMS Verification Guide
accounts.fallback_guide_note: If Method 1 does not resolve the issue or Google still demands phone verification in Cloud Shell, follow the steps below:

fix_guide.title: Terminal Quick Fix (Resolves internal 403s)
fix_guide.step1_desc: Open your Terminal and run the following command to tell Google "it's me", which resolves most 403 blocks:
fix_guide.step1_li1: Press Enter, input <1>Y</1> when prompted to continue.
fix_guide.step1_li2: Your browser will open automatically, select your account and click "Allow".
fix_guide.step1_li3: Once you see <1>You are now authenticated</1>, you're all set!
fix_guide.step2_li1_prefix: Run this to clear your old credentials:
fix_guide.tip1: If you still get 403, try running <1>unset GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS</1> in terminal first.
fix_guide.tip2: For production environments, using a <1>Service Account</1> JSON key is highly recommended for stability and headless operation.
fix_guide.tip3: If it still fails, check the Generative Language API in <1>Google Cloud Console</1> to see if permissions are frozen. If so, your account is under risk control. Please let the account cool down for 72 hours before trying again.
fix_guide.tip4: You can also try <1>npm install -g @google/gemini-cli</1>. If it doesn't throw errors, simply deleting and re-authorizing the account in the app will likely fix it.

verification_guide.card_title: Google Verification Loop Fix (Cloud Shell Bypass)
verification_guide.card_desc: Google blocks Antigravity OAuth with "Further action is required to use Antigravity IDE" because the Google account requires SMS verification in Cloud Shell before IDE access is granted.
verification_guide.step5: When the "Verify your account" popup appears, click Verify.
verification_guide.step6: Select "Verify your phone number" and complete the 6-digit SMS verification code.
verification_guide.step7: Return to Antigravity IDE login page, click Sign in, and IDE will activate immediately!
verification_guide.phone_note: If your phone number is rejected or unavailable, contact @DrGuidance on Telegram for assistance.
verification_guide.hint_banner: Encountered "Further action is required" or account verification loop?
verification_guide.open_in_system_title: Open in system default PDF viewer (Adobe Acrobat / Edge)

example.title: أمثلة الاستخدام
example.python_anthropic:
from anthropic import Anthropic

client = Anthropic(
    # Recommended: 127.0.0.1
    base_url="{{baseUrl}}",
    api_key="{{apiKey}}"
)

# Note: Antigravity supports calling any model via the Anthropic SDK
response = client.messages.create(
    model="{{modelId}}",
    max_tokens=1024,
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "مرحبًا"}]
)

print(response.content[0].text)
example.python_gemini:
# Install: pip install google-generativeai
import google.generativeai as genai

# Use Antigravity proxy address (recommended 127.0.0.1)
genai.configure(
    api_key="{{apiKey}}",
    transport='rest',
    client_options={'api_endpoint': '{{rawBaseUrl}}'}
)

model = genai.GenerativeModel('{{modelId}}')
response = model.generate_content("مرحبًا")
print(response.text)
example.python_openai_image:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="{{baseUrl}}",
    api_key="{{apiKey}}"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="{{modelId}}",
    # Option 1: use size (recommended)
    # Supported: "1024x1024" (1:1), "1280x720" (16:9), "720x1280" (9:16), "1216x896" (4:3)
    extra_body={ "size": "1024x1024" },

    # Option 2: use model suffix
    # e.g. gemini-3-pro-image-16-9, gemini-3-pro-image-4-3
    # model="gemini-3-pro-image-16-9",
    messages=[{
        "role": "user",
        "content": "ارسم مدينة مستقبلية"
    }]
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)
example.python_openai:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="{{baseUrl}}",
    api_key="{{apiKey}}"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="{{modelId}}",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "مرحبًا"}]
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)
